evidence: scene/reflect/dynamic_json.rs maps DeclaredValueType::Json to ReflectedValue::Json(value.clone()); scene/dynamic_scene/value/remap.rs recursively rewrites every single-key entity object matching a source mapping; transaction.rs invokes this for resource fields and value/json.rs for plugin components.
impact_or_question: An ordinary JSON field such as {"entity": 1} changes to the newly allocated entity ID when source entity 1 collides in the target world, even though the field is declared as arbitrary Json rather than Entity.
next_action: Define an explicit entity-reference representation for Json fields or restrict remapping to typed Entity values; add an arbitrary Json preservation regression test.

evidence: scene/validation.rs ensure_scene_supported checks duplicate source entities and component type descriptors but not duplicate DynamicResource type_path values; scene/spawn/resource.rs compile_resource_writes loops over every resource and apply_resource_writes_to_preflight writes each sequentially.
impact_or_question: A forged or edited scene may contain multiple rows for one resource; the intended contract for last-write-wins versus duplicate rejection is not documented and preview counts each row.
next_action: Decide whether resource type_path must be unique in a scene payload; enforce and test the chosen contract during scene admission.
